Absolutely blown away by this dice tower. The dragon wrapped around the castle turret is incredibly detailed, from the scales to the wings to the way it's guarding the entrance. Couldn't be happier with the result, will definitely be back for more. Highly recommended! I will go to no one else for 3D prints!
